text: Albert charges $3.50 per withdrawal at an out-of-network ATM, meaning any ATM outside the Allpoint network. The ATM operator may also add its own surcharge, even if you don't complete the transaction. If you're eligible, you can opt in to ATM fee reimbursement in the app, which waives Albert's fee and credits back operator surcharges on US withdrawals. One document, the Cardholder Agreement, lists $2.50 instead, so check the Fee Schedule in your app or contact support to confirm what applies to your account.
